name: modules/dx
description: Stand-ins that let the whole app be run and looked at with nothing else on the network.

floors.mutation-is-zero-because: A stand-in is a fake by construction, so a mutant here is measured against the thing being stood in for. What it builds is held instead: `EveryPayloadTheStandInBuildsFitsTheContractTest` runs every payload it generates against the SDK's own declared shapes, and `EveryStandInReplacesItsOwnPortTest` runs the registry — no two claiming one port, each claiming an interface, each answering with an instance of it.
